info.description:
Part 3: every request now goes through the API Gateway.
Import one of the environment files in docs, select it and fill in adminPassword.
Run the folders from top to bottom, the Auth folder saves the tokens the other folders use.
Public requests have no auth. Protected requests send Authorization: Bearer {{token}}.
